trials.description: Pure res60s1 momentum; new-high long off; new-low short off
Long: 50/50 res60s1 and 250-observation new-high breakout; Short: pure res60s1
Long: pure res60s1; Short: 50/50 res60s1 and 250-observation new-low breakout
Long and Short each blend res60s1 50/50 with their own 250-observation breakout

feature_definitions.res60s1: centered cross-sectional rank in [-1,1] of the preceding 60 observed residual-return rows per listing segment, excluding current row; min_periods=60
feature_definitions.corporate_action_scale: Within a listing segment, cumulative product of observed AdjustmentFactor event multipliers; factor 1 contributes 1. Divide raw High, Low, and Close by the scale before comparing prices.
feature_definitions.prior_high_250: Rolling max of split-safe raw High for exactly the prior 250 observed rows, excluding date t; require 250 valid High values.
feature_definitions.prior_low_250: Rolling min of split-safe raw Low for exactly the prior 250 observed rows, excluding date t; require 250 valid Low values.
feature_definitions.breakout_ranks: Daily centered percentile ranks in [-1,1] of new_high_excess and new_low_excess separately; missing 250-row history falls back to pure momentum for that side.
feature_definitions.side_ensemble: Toggle-on Long rows with res60s1 > 0: max(0, 0.5*res60s1 + 0.5*new_high_rank). Toggle-on Short rows with res60s1 < 0: min(0, 0.5*res60s1 - 0.5*new_low_rank). The other side is unchanged. Toggle-off is pure res60s1.
feature_definitions.smoothing: EWMA alpha=0.25, adjust=False per listing segment, after side-specific composition.
feature_definitions.portfolio: Existing official-compatible five-quintile score weights; unchanged for all four variants.

model: Deterministic rule-based signal blend; no fitted parameters

selection_rule.primary: Descriptive Train-only comparison of exactly four pre-registered combinations against M00; no adoption or reselection from these known data.
